This is the same ruling as the header dispute, one field further along: the packet grades the addition, not the host, and a high-confidence leaf does not become medium because a medium-confidence claim landed inside it — that would misrepresent every claim the leaf already made. The gate read the written exception correctly (it named only Theme/Area/Severity/Size), so the exception text is what was too narrow. A future augment packet should say header AND Source line.

orchestratorRulings.subject: the other three packet-fidelity defects
orchestratorRulings.detail: Unlike the header/Confidence class, 047 and 152 were real dropped or falsified predecessor claims (a no-other-leaf claim that stayed false, and a deleted boundary requiring smoke-test-files.ts to remain the extracted engine's only local runtime dependency). Not every packet-fidelity defect is the augment-header question.
